blocks.html:
Attic, under-floor and concealed spaces used for storage of combustible materials shall be protected on the storage side as required for 1-hour fire-resistance-rated construction. Openings shall be protected by assemblies that are self-closing and are of noncombustible construction or solid wood core not less than 1 3/4 inch (45 mm) in thickness.
   Exception: Neither fire-resistance-rated construction nor opening protectives are required in any of the following locations:
      1.   Areas protected by approved automatic sprinkler systems.
      2.   Group R-3 and U occupancies.
